requirements.quote: freeze-guard returns frozen for 18:00:00 to 22:59:59 and 07:00:00 to 10:29:59 IST inclusive of the start and exclusive of the end, and unfrozen otherwise, verified by boundary unit tests [type:unit]
Production deploy workflow fails at its first job with a message naming the next open window when run inside a freeze, and does not reach the SSH step [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: deploy-prod.yml first job (freeze-guard) in GitHub Actions; in lane covered by static workflow test and freeze unit tests

requirements.quote: The staging deploy is not subject to the freeze but records the same checks and runs automatically on merge to the staging branch [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: deploy-staging.yml run on push to staging

requirements.quote: Production promotion requires: the same image SHA deployed to staging, staging smoke green within the last 24 hours, and required reviewers on the `production` environment [type:manual]
requirements.evidence: deploy-prod.yml promotion job and the GitHub `production` environment (#116)

requirements.quote: Deploy order is: pull images, run expand-only migrations as the owner role, roll `api` and `worker`, then `web` containers one at a time, each gated by `/readyz` for 60 s before moving on [type:api]
requirements.evidence: deploy-test.yml job running infra/scripts/deploy.test.sh with docker

requirements.quote: A failed readiness gate triggers automatic rollback to the previously recorded image tags and posts a failure summary; the rollback path is tested in CI by deploying a deliberately unhealthy image [type:api]
requirements.evidence: deploy-test.yml job running infra/scripts/deploy.test.sh with docker

requirements.quote: The deploy never drops traffic: with two web containers, at least one is always ready (verified by a continuous probe during the deploy test) [type:api]
requirements.evidence: deploy-test.yml job running infra/scripts/deploy.test.sh with docker

requirements.quote: The hotfix workflow bypasses the freeze only when run in the `hotfix` environment with a non-empty reason; each use writes an audit comment and a Slack-compatible notification payload to a configured webhook [type:manual]
Migrations are restricted to expand-compatible operations in deploy (a static check rejects `DROP COLUMN` or `ALTER ... NOT NULL` without a prior expand release unless tagged `contract`) [type:unit]
Deploy records `release.json` (sha, time IST, deployer, migration list) on the VPS and in a GitHub deployment record; `/readyz` exposes the running sha [type:api]
requirements.evidence: deploy-test.yml asserts release.json and /readyz version; GitHub deployment record is written by deploy-*.yml

requirements.quote: Secrets used by workflows (SSH key, GHCR token, host fingerprints) come from GitHub environments; host key is pinned and verified (no `StrictHostKeyChecking=no`) [type:manual]
Deploy and freeze behaviour is documented in the court-day freeze runbook including override etiquette and the expected communications to users [type:manual]
A scheduled workflow comments a warning on any PR labelled `deploy:prod` if its merge would land inside the freeze, so planning is visible [type:unit]
Production deploys are promoted from a green staging deploy of the same image SHA.
Adapters and flags may be changed through their own safe paths during freeze only where designed to be hot-deployable.

node:test boundary tests at 07:00, 10:30, 18:00, 23:00, 22:59:59, 10:29:59, week boundaries, UTC-to-IST conversion

Add workflow_call (inputs: publish) so deploy-staging reuses the build, scan, SBOM and cosign path for the staging SHA; main behaviour unchanged

node:test cases for accepted and rejected statements plus the contract tag; run on the real migrations dir

decisions.choice: Freeze logic lives in a pure freeze.ts imported by index.ts and freeze-warning.yml; tests are node:test run through the existing test:ci-scripts runner, not a new vitest package
decisions.justification: package.json:31 already runs node --experimental-strip-types --test for CI scripts; no vitest config exists under .github

decisions.choice: Reuse images.yml through workflow_call for the staging build rather than duplicating the multi-arch/Trivy/cosign steps
decisions.justification: images.yml header documents the pinned-tool publish path; staging and prod must deploy the identical signed sha tag

decisions.choice: Add deploy-test.yml (not in the issue file list) to run deploy.test.sh and docker-dependent checks in CI, since docker is never run locally
decisions.justification: CLAUDE.md: Playwright/docker-heavy checks run in CI only; acceptance criteria R5-R7 require a CI-run deploy test

decisions.choice: Host key verification uses a pinned known_hosts value from the GitHub environment secret and ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes
decisions.justification: Issue acceptance criterion on pinned host key; credentials come from #116/#108
